title: Detection Engineering Assistant Foundation
goal: Add defensive value by mapping evidence-backed findings to detection ideas operators can review.
scope: Implement a first detection-engineering assistant output that suggests detection logic, telemetry sources, or SIEM rule starting points based on existing findings, tools, and attack scenarios. Keep output advisory and operator-reviewed.
generation_reason: Product recommendation coverage audit found detection-engineering assistant work was not represented in the backlog.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Generate advisory detection guidance only. Do not deploy SIEM rules, call customer systems, or claim detections are production-ready.
notes: Detection ideas must be traceable to evidence or attack scenarios.
Unsupported telemetry sources must be clearly marked.

success_criteria: Selected findings can show advisory detection-engineering suggestions.
Suggested telemetry and rule ideas are clearly non-production drafts.
Sparse findings and unsupported scenarios fall back truthfully.
Tests cover suggested and unsupported cases.
No external SIEM or EDR system is modified.
must_not_touch: pack registry, validation, approval, deployment, or runtime binding flows

acceptance_criteria: Detection output is advisory and evidence-linked.
No customer detection system is modified.

before_promotion: The prior active task is completed and logged.
Advisory wording and unsupported telemetry behavior are defined.
after_completion: Update DONE_LOG.md with detection-assistant changes and validation evidence.
Update CURRENT_STATE.md with the detection-assistant baseline and deployment limits.
Promote exactly one next approved task package into NEXT_TASK.md, or set an explicit holding state if the queue is exhausted.
